meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索跨会话记忆数据库，快速找回历史工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从之前的对话中找回解决方案或上下文
copy.tagline_en: Search cross-session memory database to quickly retrieve past work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to recall solutions or context from previous conversations

howto.what: 装上该技能后，当对话涉及过往工作，Claude 会先搜索记忆库，列出带 ID 的索引，再围绕相关结果查看时间线，最后只获取选定记录的完整细节。
howto.when: 当用户问起“之前解决过吗”“上次怎么做”或需要过往会话的工作内容时触发。

say.text: 我们上次是怎么修复登录报错的？
say.note: Claude 会先搜出相关索引，再获取完整记录。

say.text: 上周这个项目的讨论都有什么？
say.note: 他会列出匹配结果，再帮你查看上下文。

say.text: 帮我找一下之前关于性能优化的记录。
say.note: 先给索引，按需提取细节。

howto.what_en: After activation, Claude will search the persistent memory database, show an indexed table with IDs, inspect timelines around interesting results, then fetch full details only for selected IDs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about previous sessions, such as 'did we already solve this?', 'how did we do X last time?', or needs past session work.

say_en.text: How did we fix the login error last time?
say_en.note: Claude searches relevant records first, then answers.

say_en.text: What did we discuss on this project last week?
say_en.note: He returns an index of matching entries first, then drills down.

say_en.text: Find earlier notes about performance optimization.
say_en.note: He lists candidates with IDs, then fetches details on request.
